articles.title: Subidón de Alonso, con Leclerc en el primer puesto
articles.standfirst: El asturiano no utilizó el blando, pero entra en posiciones insospechadas
articles.summary: El asturiano no utilizó el blando, pero entra en posiciones insospechadas
articles.body: Una primera sesión de libres interesante en el GP de México, con Charles Leclerc primero, seguido por Antonelli y Vesti, el probador de Mercedes. Lo mejor del estreno en el Hnos Rodríguez fue el séptimo final de Fernando Alonso, que ni siquiera montó el compuesto blando y se colocó séptimo, a 1,2 segundos del Ferrari con el neumático medio. No es un indicativo de lo que puede pasar, pero sí un signo de que el Aston y su motor Honda se adaptan bien al trazado mexicano y a su altura de 2.240 metros. Con los blandos, que Alonso prefirió reservar, posiblemente hubiera estado a menos de un segundo del mejor tiempo, el de Ferrari, lo que sería la menor distancia de todo 2026 respecto a un primero. La valía del español, con pista sucia y poco agarre, le da un plus, pero eso ha pasado otras veces este año y nunca estuvo tan cerca. Los puntos parecen de nuevo, como en Malasia, un objetivo real para el '14' y eso ya es una buena noticia. En cuanto a los datos, Alonso se llevó el segundo mejor tiempo en el sector 3, el que corresponde al Foro Sol, con las curvas más lentas del trazado, lo que denota la eficiencia del actual chasis del AMR26 tras su doble evolución de este año. Por su parte, Carlos Sainz acabó 16º, en una sesión en la que tampoco montó lo blandos y donde empezó muy fuerte pero hubo de ceder ante la poca eficiencia de su coche en curva. Llegar a la Q2 el sábado es el principal objetivo del madrileño. Es cierto que es una sesión muy engañosa, por la baja de 10 pilotos titulares sustituidos por novatos, pero las diferencias de tiempos respecto a la cabeza no deben olvidarse. El quinto de Iwasa (Red Bull) con los medios augura a un Verstappen muy fuerte en los libres 2 y el resto del fin de semana. Con la pista muy sucia y con un juego de medios. Fernando (medios), se metía quinto, tras dos gallos como Leclerc, Antonelli, Hamilton e Iwasa (Red Bull). Las 10 bajas de entre los titulares ayudaba, pero el mérito era evidente para el asturiano. Carlos Sainz era 14º con el duro, algo mejor de lo esperado. Era sólo un aperitivo, sin embargo. Tiempos, cortesía de formula-timer.com.

articles.title: Alonso recibe una multa en México por 0,2 km/h
articles.standfirst: Excedió la velocidad permitida en boxes en los libres 1
articles.summary: Excedió la velocidad permitida en boxes en los libres 1
articles.body: Fernando Alonso ha sido sancionado con una multa económica en el GP de México, por exceder los límites de velocidad en la sesión de libres 1. La FIA se lo ha comunicado oficialmente. Este tipo de sanciones, que dependen de cómo se ha calibrado el limitador de velocidad por los técnico, son asumidas por el equipo. Hecho: Exceso de velocidad en el 'pit lane' (calle de boxes) – 80,2 km/h. Infracción: Incumplimiento del artículo B1.6.3a del Reglamento de F1 de la FIA. Decisión: Se impone una multa de 100 € al competidor (Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team). Motivo: El coche n.º 14 superó en 0,2 km/h el límite de velocidad en el 'pit lane', establecido en 80 km/h para este evento.

articles.title: Libres 2 F1 del GP de México: resumen, resultado y tiempos de Alonso y Sainz
articles.summary: Antes de cerrar... os recordamos horarios de mañana. Libres 3 = 19.30 Clasificación = 23.00 Desde aquí os contaremos todo lo que suceda y, por supuest
articles.body:
Segundo y último entrenamiento del viernes en el Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez . Un Gran Premio de México muy especial, pues coincide con su fiesta grande, El Día de Muertos . No obstante, y a pesar de la emoción que les supone a los mexicanos que ambos eventos coincidan, lo importante este fin de semana es, sin lugar a duda, el hito que está a punto de conseguir el joven piloto italiano, Kimi Antonelli , llevándose el Título Mundial de F1 .

Sin embargo, no se lo pondrán tan fácil, pues los Ferrari van bien en este circuito y tratarán de remediar el "desastre" que finalmente supuso la carrera en Austin, tras haber dominado todo el fin de semana y no haber conseguido, ni la victoria, ni el doblete.

Así pues, el Libre 1 ha estado comandado por el monegasco, Charles Leclerc , quien ha conseguido un tiempo de 1.18.128 sobre, precisamente el líder del Mundial, Kimi Antonelli, sacándole 659 milésimas . Mientras, el ' Rookie ' Frederik Vesti, subido en el coche de Russell, ha logrado posicionarse 3º , a 733 milésimas del monegasco. Hamilton ha cerrado el "sándwich" que han hecho los Ferrari a los Mercedes, con un 4º puesto.

Por otro lado, los españoles vuelven a ser la cara y la cruz de la moneda. Por un lado, Fernando Alonso ha vuelto a poner su magia encima de la mesa y sacarle provecho a un coche que, claramente, es inferior al resto. El asturiano ha logrado un 7º puesto en la sesión matutina (tarde en la Península Ibérica), con un tiempo de 1.19.357 . No obstante, Carlos Sainz se ha llevado la peor parte, pues tan sólo ha podido alcanzar el 16º puesto y un tiempo de 1.20.006 , a más de segundo y medio de su excompañero de equipo, Charles Leclerc .

articles.title: Breeders' Cup: Sun Goddess in class of her own with Juvenile Fillies Turf win at Keeneland as Libertango takes Juvenile Turf Sprint
articles.summary: Sun Goddess capped off a memorable two-year-old season with a fourth success at the top level with a scintillating display in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf on a winning night for the European raiders at Keeneland; Libertango won the opening Juvenile Turf Sprint
articles.body:
Seen by many as the banker of the two-day meeting, she already had three Group Ones in Europe to her credit but she had to contend with the journey to America and stall nine.

However, Ryan Moore got her out of the stalls sharply and across to the inside in the perfect position just behind the leader whereas her main market rival, Francis-Henri Graffard's Amusingly, had to settle at the rear of the field.

As soon as Moore kicked clear early in the straight the race was over as a contest and once again it was left to Joseph O'Brien's Green Empress to chase her home, the fourth time she has been second to the winner this year.

Johnny Murtagh's Curracloe ran a fine race to finish third while Amusingly made late gains under Colin Keane for fourth. Joseph O'Brien's Alwaysanangel finished fifth in a clean sweep for the Europeans.

It was Aidan O'Brien's 22nd Breeders' Cup winner, meaning he has now had more winners at the meeting than anybody else, having been previously tied with Bob Baffert.

O'Brien said: "She was just really natural all the way from day one.

"She obviously had a run or two before Royal Ascot and she's taken everything in her stride.

"We could have taken in the Fillies' Mile in Newmarket on the way, and the lads just decided this with the view to next year. They wanted her here, so that's why she's here.

"Whether it's six furlongs, seven or even a mile now it all comes alike to her.

"Ryan just lets her come out and he lets her get comfortable in the first half and in the second half she comes home really well.

"I suppose a worry today was we all know what she can do when there's a strong pace on in front of her. He thought that he was going to end up a lot more forward than usual on her because he wasn't sure what was going to take her. So that's exactly what he did.

"I thought he gave her a beautiful ride. It was all very clean cut, no chances. The filly had a lovely day out.

"We usually start this kind of filly in the Guineas, I'd imagine the English Guineas is where she will start and there's a chance she might stay further."

Moore said: "What she's done this year is very unique, that is her fourth Group One from nine starts, that was her first over a mile though and the first time round a bend.

"There was a lot new to her but she was able to sit just off the pace and the pace was very ordinary really, we felt like we went a lot slower than we normally do in Cup races over a mile here.

"She was in front a long way from home and she was only idling really. It's hard to know where the bottom is for her. Hopefully she can continue next year."

Co-owner Michael Tabor said: "To win wherever the Breeders' Cup is held is very special because it's great competition and the crowds make it.

"I love American racing but it's tougher (to win) out here. Paul Shanahan buys so many of our horses and the irony of it is that this is maybe the cheapest (£120,000) he's bought but probably the best."

O'Brien went on to notch his 23rd Breeders' Cup success when Haffner claimed the Juvenile Turf.

Libertango delivers for Boughey and late sub Loughnane

Libertango came with a sustained late run under substitute jockey Billy Loughnane to win the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf Sprint at Keeneland.

In the days leading up to the race new UK champion jockey Loughnane had resigned himself to not taking the mount as her weight of 8st 7lb was 3lb lower than he had ridden at all season.

Loughnane could not face the prospect of seeing someone else take the mount, though, and having made a concerted effort in recent days to keep the weight off, one final stint in the sauna saw him meet the required point on the scales and trainer George Boughey was only happy to stand by his stable jockey.

Flavien Prat was the unlucky man to miss out, but bar meeting a slight but of trouble on the turn for home behind Andrew Balding's Moonrise, everything else went to plan.

Wesley Ward's Ruiva was the one to catch before Harper's Corner briefly hit the front only for Libertango to swamp them all. Adrian Keatley's Hell Of A Spin ran a massive race to get up for second.

Loughnane said: "I don't know what to say. I've ridden this filly in every single race and in every piece of work she's ever done and I thought I was going to have to give up the ride on her today.

"I've watched my weight for the last two weeks, obviously condolences to Flavien but I managed to just get enough off in the sauna and I'm sat on the smallest saddle I've ever ridden on. It's good to be able to get the weight off.

"It was awful thinking someone else was going to ride her but big thanks to George and all the team, it was literally 45 minutes before the race it was confirmed.

"She has such a good racing brain, she went to sleep. There was interference on the turn but she didn't even break stride and when I moved her out she hit the wire fantastic.

"I'm riding at 8st 10lb later on so I'd been aiming for that and I'd never been down to 8st 5lb all the time I've been riding, but it's a massive advantage having saunas here, we don't have them in England."

Boughey said: "Credit to Billy I didn't think he would do the weight but the saunas helped and it's the stuff of dreams. All credit to Billy as that was some ride.

"Flavien was meant to ride and it was a very late decision. Billy had ridden her all year and he text me when he got to the track saying he weighed in a lot lighter than he expected. I'd like to apologise to Flavien because he'd been booked a while and it was probably one of his better mounts of the day.

"The race look mapped out for her even from Royal Ascot. That was the plan to come here and for her to train as well as she did through the last few races, it wasn't a huge surprise that she was able to put in a performance like that today.

"The Breeders' Cup for me is as good as it gets. She's been ridden so beautifully by Billy all year. To say he wasn't riding her until 55 minutes before the race, he's just an extraordinary talent."

articles.title: Alonso 'se tira' al cuello de Albon... para hacer las paces
articles.standfirst: Fernando bromeó con el de Williams en la Fan Zone de México, para limar asperezas
articles.summary: Fernando bromeó con el de Williams en la Fan Zone de México, para limar asperezas
articles.body: Una curiosa imagen que parece sellar la paz entre Fernando Alonso y Alex Albon, después de que el tailandés arruinara su carrera de la semana pasada en Austin. Después de eso, ha habido cruce de declaraciones de ida y vuelta. Alonso reiteraba en México, "no entiendo lo que vio Albon para tirarse allí", mientras el compañero de Sainz se plantaba. "No estoy de acuerdo con Fernando, tan sencillo como eso". En un momento de este viernes, los dos han coincidido en una comparecencia ante los aficionados en la Fan Zone del circuito. Fernando le agarraba por el cuello en tono de broma y Albon lo aceptaba sonriente en señal de paz. Luego le daba la mano amistosamente a Carlos Sainz. Parece que el rifi-rafe ha quedado zanjado con buen humor, ya que todos comprenden las circunstancias de estar luchando en la zona trasera de la parrilla de este año.

images.caption: Alonso y Albon este viernes en el circuito de México. F1.com
